name: hds-spotlight-hover
title: Spotlight Hover
description: Cursor-following radial glow, card lift and violet border transition.
notes: Independent implementation of the visual behavior. Fine pointers only; retain focus-visible and motion fallbacks.

name: hds-service-card
title: Illustrated Service Card
description: Service card composition combining a hover spotlight with miniature artwork.
notes: Expose title, description, link and illustration kind. Avoid nesting interactive controls inside links.

name: hds-gradient-palette
title: Violet Pink Amber Palette
description: Exact light/dark tokens and the signature 110-degree gradients.
notes: Text gradient: #7941a0 → #a73880 → #a95425. Surface gradient: #b697fa → #efa1d0 → #ffc293, stops 0%, 52%, 100%, angle 110deg. Scope tokens when the host uses other variables.

name: hds-gradient-text
title: Gradient Typography
description: Readable gradient text using the darker palette in light mode.
notes: Use --accent-gradient for text, --accent-surface-gradient for fills. Keep text as semantic HTML.

name: hds-gradient-button
title: Gradient Pill Button
description: Rounded gradient CTA with arrow and brightness hover.
notes: Use a real button for actions and an anchor for navigation. Keep the 52px control height and dark text.

name: hds-ambient-glow
title: Ambient Gradient Glow
description: Soft violet, pink and amber radial lighting behind artwork.
notes: Keep decorative layers behind content and noninteractive. Avoid blurring text.

name: hds-grid-surface
title: Technical Grid Surface
description: Subtle 24px grid for diagrams and illustration backgrounds.
notes: Keep grid contrast quiet; apply radial masks to decorative overlays when needed.

name: hds-robot-orb
title: Animated Robot Sphere
description: Procedural Three.js pearl sphere with autonomous gaze, blink and float.
notes: Copy the renderer, fallback SVG and wrapper together. Preserve lazy loading, offscreen/hidden-tab pause, renderer disposal and motion preferences. No external 3D models required.

name: hds-tech-text
title: Interactive Technical Text
description: ReactBits technical text with sweep, outlined glyphs and spring-return dragging.
notes: Upstream-install recipe only. Do not copy ReactBits source into a redistributed component library. Install the current official TechText TS CSS registry component directly in the consuming application; keep static text, fine-pointer dragging, Arabic word shaping and reduced-motion fallback.

name: hds-sketch-mascot
title: Animated Line Mascot
description: Original robot line drawing with periodic blinking and changing gaze.
notes: Support animated=false for compact logos. Keep decorative SVG aria-hidden and halt motion when requested.

name: hds-website-graphic
title: Website Service Illustration
description: Tilted miniature browser, phone and pointer that align on hover.
notes: Use kind="website" within data-ui="service-card" to activate the existing CSS hover behavior.

name: hds-redesign-graphic
title: Redesign Service Illustration
description: Layered before-and-after screens with hover transforms.
notes: Use kind="redesign" within data-ui="service-card".

name: hds-assistant-graphic
title: Assistant Service Illustration
description: Miniature knowledge documents and chat preview.
notes: Use kind="assistant" within data-ui="service-card".

name: hds-dashboard-graphic
title: Dashboard Service Illustration
description: Miniature dashboard whose chart bars respond on hover.
notes: Use kind="dashboard" within data-ui="service-card".

name: hds-product-graphic
title: Product Service Illustration
description: Connected product nodes that shift subtly on hover.
notes: Use kind="product" within data-ui="service-card".

name: hds-browser-transform
title: Browser Transformation
description: Original vector animation reorganizing a plain website into a polished layout.
notes: Use the native Web Animations controller with the complete vector art. Preserve its 13s cycle and offscreen pause. SVG IDs must be unique per instance.

name: hds-responsive-showcase
title: Responsive Website Showcase
description: Authored desktop and phone website presentation with expandable studio details.
notes: This is illustrative sample content; replace business copy for real products. Scope expandable details to each instance.

name: hds-browser-frame
title: Desktop Browser Frame
description: Rounded browser shell with chrome dots for product previews.
notes: Accept arbitrary children and a descriptive label. Preserve contained width and clipping.

name: hds-phone-frame
title: Phone Device Frame
description: Dark rounded phone shell and tall clipped screen.
notes: Use the 375/812 screen ratio, 36px outer radius, and 25px inner radius.

name: hds-device-comparison
title: Before After Device Comparison
description: Toggle synchronized desktop and mobile previews of two designs.
notes: Supply before and after desktop/mobile images. Keep aria-pressed state and meaningful alt text.

name: hds-scroll-reveal
title: Scroll Reveal
description: Once-per-mount 24px rise and fade for content entering the viewport.
notes: Static HTML stays visible before hydration and for reduced motion. This uses native Web Animations instead of the site GSAP reveal; duration remains 700ms.

name: hds-process-timeline
title: Scroll Progress Timeline
description: Four-stage process with a scroll-drawn gradient connector and mobile vertical layout.
notes: Retain GSAP ScrollTrigger scrubbing and matchMedia cleanup. Default geometry is four stages; adjust connector width for other counts.

name: hds-project-card
title: Project Preview Card
description: Editorial project image card with subtle hover zoom.
notes: Supply project content and images through props. Preserve 1200/645 media ratio and lazy loading.

name: hds-carousel
title: Snap Carousel
description: Horizontal snap track with previous/next controls, count and RTL support.
notes: Use bounding-box distances for direction-aware scroll targets; preserve disabled controls and instant reduced-motion scrolling.

name: hds-section-heading
title: Editorial Section Heading
description: Numbered overline and large tightly spaced display typography.
notes: Preserve display font, weight 800, -0.045em tracking and responsive clamp. Match host heading hierarchy.

name: hds-arrow-link
title: Arrow Link Hover
description: Text link whose northeast arrow shifts on hover.
notes: Maintain 44px target height and mark the icon decorative.

name: hds-theme-tokens
title: Light Dark Theme Tokens
description: Semantic colors and an optional theme toggle for the portfolio palette.
notes: The example toggle changes html data-theme and persists hds-theme. Do not override existing host theme control; use tokens as the visual reference.

name: hds-contribution-heatmap
title: Violet Contribution Heatmap
description: Seven-row activity chart with a five-step violet intensity scale.
notes: Accept caller data rather than bundled personal GitHub activity. Each week is seven intensity values from 0 to 4.

name: hds-product-system
title: Connected Product Diagram
description: Input, core and output architecture figure with a gradient connection line.
notes: React adaptation of the static diagram. The original site scroll-scrubbed the connector; this exported diagram is static and should be animated only when requested.

name: hds-chat-demo
title: Grounded Chat Interface
description: Sample knowledge sidebar, chat bubbles, suggested questions and expandable citations.
notes: Local prepared-answer demonstration; no AI backend is included. Replace knowledge and messaging transport for production. Retain reset, busy state and source disclosure.

name: hds-dashboard-demo
title: Interactive Workspace Dashboard
description: Sample sidebar, metrics, searchable sortable table and record dialog.
notes: Local sample data only. The original uses React state/manual table logic; when extending in a real app prefer TanStack Table/Query, React Hook Form with Yup, date-fns and Zustand when warranted.

name: hds-ui-primitives
title: Rounded UI Primitives
description: Portfolio buttons, badges, inputs, labels and accessible Radix dialog.
notes: Preserve Radix keyboard/focus behavior and shadcn MIT attribution. If the host already has daisyUI or shadcn controls, adapt styling instead of replacing its component system.
